title: See What I See
subtitle: People trust their own judgment. It's no surprise.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Let me go! Where are you taking me?!

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: You ...
If I let go, you will fall, and death will be your end.
Hold your life dear. You are a lot more vulnerable than you can imagine.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Quit threatening me. It's a river down there.
Yes. But you don't know how shallow it is. Even a lantern can't float on it!
It's dying, unlike the other branches you saw outside the city.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: So what? Does that explain why you captured me?

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Fine. The river is dying; I'm held by a bird man in mid-air; I'll fall and die if I struggle. There's nothing I can do.
Yes. It's a rare wisdom for a girl of your age to know her limits.
But I am not a bird man. I'm a Yāo.
My name is Gětiān.
Yenisei gives up on her midair struggle, pondering over his name and identity.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: You can use arcane skills. You're an arcanist.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: If you say so, then it is so.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: We have gone for miles. I will leave you here. Beyond the ford, you will see the steppe.
Gětiān slows down, just as he said he would, and after a moment, he gently places Yenisei on the ground.
Given her situation, she had not anticipated such gentle treatment.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: I don't understand. What on earth is your purpose?

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Why did you turn humans into horses? I believe you can commit much worse crimes if you want to.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Are you doing it for fun?
Gětiān stops to the side of a curved tree growing like a bridge over the vines of a shallow stream, face heavy with a look of contemplation.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: The more you ask, the more mistakes you make.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: There's no such thing as a wrong question.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: I will answer one of the questions, regarding ... why I turned people into horses.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: The answer is, I didn't do it. Neither did I have that intention.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Hah, interesting. Who did it then?

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: The lady owner of the tavern.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Jiǔ Niángzǐ?

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: Precisely.
Yenisei shakes her head, not believing his words.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: If that's the case, why did you leave Madam Bessmert there alone? Do you really think I would buy your nonsense after I saw you take my teammates away?

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: You saw the "horse" in the yard, with the red tail and the red mane. Did you not?

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Yes, I saw ...

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: It's not a "horse." It's a Lùshǔ, or at least, it looks like one.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Lùshǔ ... I have never heard of it before. It sounds like an arcane creature native to the East.
Gětiān doesn't respond. He only continues to contribute yet more astonishing information.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: It is a Lùshǔ, and also Jiǔ Niángzǐ herself.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: What? That thing is Jiǔ Niángzǐ?!

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: What you saw tonight was not real Lùshǔ. Those "horses" merely resembled half of them.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: I speak of the fact that Jiǔ Niángzǐ might be a Lùshǔ, a kind of Yāo, or, as you would put it, an arcane creature.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: *sighs* Your words sound even more complicated than those in the city.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Is it because you are also an arcane creature like the Lùshǔ? Or, you have a thing only the pure-blooded can understand?

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: We are nothing alike. Lùshǔs are Xiángruìs, born with red manes and white faces, covered with tiger's markings.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: In the books, Lùshǔs are capable of casting an arcane skill named The Shape of Will. It could be the same skill that Jiǔ Niángzǐ uses to turn others into Lùshǔs.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: Do you understand?

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Yes ... I'll try.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: The Shape of Will is a dangerous and secret skill, as written in the books. The Lùshǔs use it to transform blood into fire and stone into gold.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: So ... it's like alchemy?

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: I'm unfamiliar with what you said, but ...

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: Jiǔ Niángzǐ's power seems to be restricted. She cannot fully transform into a Lùshǔ like a Yāo could, nor does she possess great power. She's closer to a Half Yāo.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: Unlike other Lùshǔs, she requires a certain medium to cast her skill, The Shape of Will. This is also why people did not recognize her. She's harder to identify.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Jiǔ Niángzǐ ... "Half Yāo" ... Is that another name for the mixed-blood?

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Anyway, even if you're telling the truth, how did you know that?

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: It is within my bloodline. Like you find your direction through the water, I read people through their bones.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: ...! How did you know my ...

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Wait, you mean you can read people through their bones? That makes no sense. What can one's physical condition tell you?

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: Many. Many stories, many sounds. Even if I was never there with them.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: Such as you. The markings on your bones resemble an open net, yet it captures nothing. You are away from the waterless land where you once lived, and to this day you're still wandering.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: What ...
The girl's eyes widen with astonished disbelief.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: You will travel far many times in life and turn homeward, like the migratory birds.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: Until you find your lake.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: What on earth are you talking about ...

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: Have I mistaken anything? I should hope not.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: Forgive me. I have long since stopped reading others' bones and put them into words.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: Perhaps I did not tell it in the most precise way, but it should be generally accurate.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Alright, stop.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: Hmm?

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: I need ...

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: I need some time to digest your words ...
A bizarre spectral sound cuts off Yenisei's reply.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: Careful!
Strange creatures that resemble balls dragging long tails suddenly leap out from the trees behind the two of them.
They shriek and charge towards Yenisei, who is most evidently their target.

items.speaker: Zhuye the Monster
items.text: Squeak!

items.speaker: Zhuye the Monster
items.text: Squeak! Squeak! Squeak!

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Ugh!

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: These things again ... They already attacked me once in the street!

items.speaker: Zhuye the Monster
items.text: Squeak!!

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: *sighs* These stupid birds!
Following closely behind is a mysterious creature markedly different from the other feathered balls.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: This one is shining bright! Get out of my way, out!
It is indeed exceptionally bright and long, illuminating the shallow stream in front of them on both sides.
Gětiān stares in the direction the scattered Zhúyè ran off, his mind burdened with thought.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: Have you drunk the liquor ... offered by Jiǔ Niángzǐ?

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: No, but I had the water from her. Why?

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: These Zhúyè might be attracted here by the scent of liquor. They feed on the flowers of Zhúyè, which can be used to make liquor and smell of lees.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: They could be here because they smelt the liquor. But you only had the water. What else could attract them?
Yenisei thinks back to the preceding events.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: If they were attracted by the scent of liquor, I think it was the wooden dolls' fault. They soaked themselves in the liquor before they attacked me. I might have gotten their scent during the battle.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: The scent of liquor stains is not strong enough to attract them here. It would have taken a proper consumption of liquor for them to notice.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: I worry that liquor is the medium for her transformation skill, but that is only my speculation. If the water you drank also exerts the same effect on you ...
As though his words hold the power of execution, the change happens the very moment he speaks.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Emm ...

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: What? You ...
Yenisei kneels down and her body transforms, just as her companions transformed on the steppes before her.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: How so ...!
Although Gětiān had already anticipated this moment, he cannot help but be startled by this strange process and flaps his wings involuntarily.
His instincts tell him to flee.
Night falls. The rain has stopped, and the riverbank is moist and soft.
Fǎcáo leads his team in search of the red-haired horse's trail, finally arriving at the edge of the river.
The exact spot where Gětiān and Yenisei stayed the night before.

items.speaker: Facao
items.text: Find anything?

items.speaker: Guard
items.text: Someone was here. Seems like a horse, with a female, tall and thin.

items.speaker: Facao
items.text: Not a horse, but a foal. Look carefully. The footsteps are smaller and shallower than a horse's.

items.speaker: Facao
items.text: Where are the ends of the tracks?

items.speaker: Guard
items.text: The river beach ahead. The tracks stopped three meters away. We couldn't tell where they went.

items.speaker: Facao
items.text: That can't be.
Fǎcáo strides over to inspect the traces near where the trail of footprints ends.

items.speaker: Guard
items.text: It rained a couple of times. The rain could have washed away the footprints.

items.speaker: Facao
items.text: If that's the case, there shouldn't be other tracks here.

items.speaker: Facao
items.text: Like this. A bird's claw marks at the edge of the rotten wood.

items.speaker: Facao
items.text: It was a bird of prey. And judging from the size and the sharpness, it's quite strong.

items.speaker: Guard
items.text: It's true ...

items.speaker: Guard
items.text: Hey, I found another two sets of footprints!

items.speaker: Guard
items.text: They are shallow and narrow, possibly from the same person, a young woman.

items.speaker: Facao
items.text: The wood lies on the ground near the river. It's not a good spot for birds of prey to roost on.

items.speaker: Facao
items.text: What stopped here was something even bigger.

items.speaker: Facao
items.text: A young woman met a huge bird of prey here, yet there is no bloodstain at all.

items.speaker: Facao
items.text: Perhaps the truth behind the foreign merchant's disappearance is different from the feather man's statement.

items.speaker: Facao
items.text: We need to go back to the Zhící.
On the steppes, a Lùshǔ stands in place of a girl. The fright of this transformation sends Gětiān up into the air.

items.speaker: Lushu
items.text: *neighs*

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: Too late.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: So it seems her tea can also transform people. I must report this to the authorities.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: Stay here.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: No, no. You must not leave!

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: You ... can speak through the water?

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: You know what my arcane skill can do! But I can't maintain it for long. I spent too much energy fighting the Zhúyès ...

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: I must take leave.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Where are you going? You need to save Madam Bessmert!

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Please, please, I'm begging you! Please save her. She can't see, and she's still alone in the tavern. She must be in great danger now ...

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: I have thought about it, given that my wand was also left in that tavern. But should I return, Jiǔ Niángzǐ might be alerted.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: I sense kindness in that girl. She hasn't done anything evil except for turning people into Lùshǔs. Your friend should be safe with her for the moment.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: The more urgent matter is to spread the word before she further repeats her mistake.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: I must go find someone to handle this properly.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Please take me with you.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: They believe you are the one behind the missing persons cases now. You'll be turning yourself in if you go alone.
Gětiān is startled, having never thought such an outcome might occur.

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: I see. The world outside the mountains is indeed not meant for me to step into.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: But you are already involved. Besides, we gave Lǐzhèng a drawing of you when I was not clear of the truth ...

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: No matter. I will reason with him.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Even so, you will need me there. Look at my arcane skill. It will be the best proof, right?

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: So they will know that Jiǔ Niángzǐ is the real culprit who turned the people into horses, I mean, "Lùshǔs."

items.speaker: Getian
items.text: Is that really needed?

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: You need to know that you are a suspect! Even though I know you are innocent, you need something absolutely persuasive to prove it.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: All in all, you must take me with you. My arcane skill will vindicate you.
